svg.text: LIVING PORTRAITS/ Architecture v3 (gen live local; 6 modules in; integrating)

Self-aware theatrical portraits on two LED panels, free + fully local on supercommons2. Deterministic PLAYER performs pre-baked beats; async qwen3 STAGE-MANAGER composes them; a local generative pipeline backfills the art. Nothing runs in realtime.

Legend: green = built & running · cyan = built + verified, wiring/deploy next · amber = next phase · violet = contract · red = pending (off-site). Reality: first portrait RENDERED locally (SD1.5 cached on SC2) · 6 modules built+verified · integration team wiring now · SC2 dep-install + LED mapping pending.
INPUTS / SIGNALS (director/signals.py + director/feeds.py) · the "important data" the world reacts to
THE SIGNAL + Calendar + weather · 30-min TTL cache · offline-degrade to stub
DIRECTOR / BRAIN (director/stage_manager.py) · qwen3:8b via local Ollama · format=json · /no_think · --loop 45s
running; pauses only during a portrait render, then resumes
action clamped to a fixed 7-verb vocabulary
CONTROL CHANNEL · the only seam between brain and stage
player mtime-polls ~2Hz · never reads a half-written file
PLAYER / STAGE (player.py) · pygame, borderless 448x256 @ (0,0), top-most + windowless, console session 1
OUTPUT / EDGE · desktop framebuffer -> LED sending card -> panels
grabs the region, maps each sub-rect to a panel
only the physical card grab is unconfirmed (Ray off-site)
GENERATIVE PIPELINE · offline / async backfill · 6 modules BUILT + verified; producer + wiring in progress
runs detached + local on the 2080 Ti, slow is fine (not realtime)
team building locally now; conductor wires into player.py + deploys to SC2
install Piper on SC2 to voice it
SDXL 13GB snapshot kept stalling on SC2's
flaky HF link; pivoted to SD1.5 (~4GB) -
no cloud once deps are local on SC2. Feeds
degrade to local cache/stub when offline.
PRINCIPLES everything-local-to-SC2 · no-realtime · deterministic-player · async-generative-backfill · fourth-wall-always-on · verify-before-the-library · long-jobs-detached · share-the-box-politely

BUILT + VERIFIED live text-aside show on SC2 · qwen3 director loop · first portrait RENDERED local (SD1.5) · 6 modules by a 6-agent team: clip graph/player, segment+rig spec, verify gate, feeds+TTL, TTS+visemes, at-logon watchdog

NEXT wire stage_render (portrait) + rig.py (animate) into player.py · install SAM / InsightFace / Piper on SC2 · deploy at-logon watchdog · orchestrate producer loop · img2vid bridges · confirm LED mapping on-site

NOW integration team lp-integrate-3e7a building compositor + rig runtime + producer; director live; portrait done. projects/living-portraits/living-portraits-architecture-v3.svg · 2026-05-26 · supersedes v2
